summary_en: This phase 2 trial tests odronextamab given before CAR-T cell therapy as bridging therapy in adults with relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma. Odronextamab is given by intravenous infusion, with step-up dosing in cycle 1, then 160 mg weekly in cycles 2 to 4, then 320 mg every other week for the remaining cycles. The main outcome measure is not stated; the record describes the trial as phase 2.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 evalúa odronextamab administrado antes de la terapia con células CAR-T como terapia puente en adultos con linfoma de células B grandes recidivante o refractario. Odronextamab se administra por infusión intravenosa, con dosis escalonadas en el ciclo 1, luego 160 mg semanales en los ciclos 2 a 4 y después 320 mg cada dos semanas en los ciclos restantes. La medida de resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el registro describe el estudio como de fase 2.
who_for: Histologically confirmed large B-cell lymphoma of the listed types, such as DLBCL, primary mediastinal, or high grade B-cell lymphoma.
At least one measurable lesion of 15 mm or more on PET, CT, or MRI.
Lymphoma failed prior frontline therapy and the patient meets criteria for a commercial CAR-T therapy.
Prior treatment with an anti-CD20 antibody therapy.
ECOG performance status 0 to 1; status 2 may be allowed if caused by lymphoma, at physician discretion.
not_for: Malignant cells in cerebrospinal fluid, or brain metastases (history of secondary CNS lymphoma may be allowed under conditions).
Prior anti-CD20 x anti-CD3 bispecific therapy, unless specific response and CD20 conditions are met.
Prior allogeneic stem cell transplant or any prior CAR-T cell therapy.
Known active, uncontrolled infection; HIV or chronic hepatitis B or C, with some exceptions.
